title: Tuuta Bade
intro: Sagalee hawaasa seenaan isaa dalga keessatti barreeffame dura dhaabbatta. Lubbuuwwan kun waamicha dhaga’anii, mormii filatanii, bu’aa lafa irra deebi’ee boce isaan mudate. Isaan eenyu, addunyaan isaanii maal ta'e?
clues: Bara dheeraa dura jiraannee, ergamaan tokko of keessaa nutti dhufe.
Waaqolii tolfamoo shan waaqeffannee dhiisuu didde.
Ergamaa sanatti qoosnee karaa irraa maqe jennee himatne.
Yoo dhugaa dubbate adabbii akka fidu gaafanne.
Samiin rooba roobsee lafti burqaa akka dhangalaasu argine.
Miliquuf gara iddoowwan olkaʼaatti ol baane, dalgaa garuu nu bira gaʼe.

outcome.label: Bu'aa
options: Nuhun wajjiin amantoota malee hundi keenya badne
outcome.answer: Nuhun wajjiin amantoota malee hundi keenya badne

arabic: قَالَ نُوحٌۭ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِى وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارًۭا
verse: Noah said, "My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss. (71:21)
